source_caption:
Land of Bad (2024) is an action war thriller that follows Air Force combat controller Kinney as he joins a dangerous special operations mission in the Philippines. What begins as a carefully planned operation quickly turns into a fight for survival when the team finds itself trapped behind enemy lines.
Kinney is still relatively inexperienced compared with the soldiers around him, but the mission becomes far more dangerous when their extraction plan falls apart. Suddenly, he must navigate hostile territory while trying to keep himself and the remaining members of the team alive.
High above the battlefield, Air Force drone pilot Eddie “Reaper” Grimm provides critical support from a remote operations center. Although Reaper is physically far from the fighting, his decisions become just as important as the actions of the soldiers on the ground.
As the situation deteriorates, communication, timing, and trust become essential. Kinney has to rely on information from people he cannot see while making decisions under extreme pressure, knowing that a single mistake could cost lives.
The film explores themes of brotherhood, leadership, sacrifice, trust, and survival. It also highlights the contrast between modern technology and the reality of close combat, showing how people thousands of miles apart can become completely dependent on one another.
What makes Land of Bad compelling is the constant tension between the battlefield and the people supporting it remotely. The characters may be separated by distance, but every decision connects them directly to the consequences on the ground.
Overall, Land of Bad combines intense military action with a survival story centered on teamwork and trust. It shows how quickly a controlled operation can become a desperate fight when everything starts going wrong.
💬 If you were trapped behind enemy lines with communication as your only connection to help, would you trust the person guiding you from miles away?

source_details.synopsis: Land of Bad is a 2024 American action thriller film directed by William Eubank, who co-wrote the script with David Frigerio. The film stars Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Ricky Whittle, and Milo Ventimiglia, and follows a US Army Delta Force team on a rescue operation that comes under attack from terrorists. Land of Bad was released theatrically on February 16, 2024. It grossed $7 million worldwide.
